import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    events = inputs["events"].copy()

    # Ensure proper dtype
    events["event_ts"] = pd.to_datetime(events["event_ts"])

    # Sort by user_id, then event_ts, then event_id (tie-breaking order)
    events = events.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "event_ts", "event_id"], kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Normalize to midnight for calendar-date comparison (avoids date/NaT type issues)
    events["event_day"] = events["event_ts"].dt.normalize()

    # Previous event's timestamp and day, within same user
    grp = events.groupby("user_id", sort=False)
    events["prev_event_ts"] = grp["event_ts"].shift(1)
    events["prev_event_day"] = grp["event_day"].shift(1)

    # Gap as a Timedelta (avoid float precision issues around the 45-min boundary)
    gap = events["event_ts"] - events["prev_event_ts"]

    is_first = events["prev_event_ts"].isna()
    gap_exceeds = (~is_first) & (gap > pd.Timedelta(minutes=45))
    diff_day = (~is_first) & (events["event_day"] != events["prev_event_day"])

    new_session = is_first | gap_exceeds | diff_day

    # Session numbering per user
    events["session_num"] = new_session.groupby(events["user_id"]).cumsum().astype("int64")

    # Aggregate into sessions
    user_sessions = events.groupby(["user_id", "session_num"], sort=False).agg(
        session_date=("event_day", "first"),
        session_start=("event_ts", "min"),
        session_end=("event_ts", "max"),
        event_count=("event_id", "count"),
    ).reset_index()

    # session_date as plain datetime (date component only, time = midnight)
    user_sessions["session_date"] = pd.to_datetime(user_sessions["session_date"])

    # Column order
    user_sessions = user_sessions[
        ["user_id", "session_num", "session_date", "session_start", "session_end", "event_count"]
    ]

    # Final sort
    user_sessions = user_sessions.sort_values(
        by=["user_id", "session_num"], kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"user_sessions": user_sessions}
